body.title: Evidence-to-action formative loop

elements.label: Intended learning
elements.supporting_text: Shapes what evidence is worth eliciting.

elements.label: Action
elements.supporting_text: Feasible next step that may generate further evidence.

relationships.meaning: Evidence is interpreted, not merely collected.

body.caption: Intended learning, evidence, interpretation and action form a recurring formative loop.

materials.formal_notes: AUTHOR-ONLY S2: Represent as a recurring relationship; do not invent extra stages.

body.title: Peer judgement inside the same loop
body.scenario: In a seminar module, students exchange draft abstracts. The lecturer wants peers to contribute judgement without inventing a separate assessment stage.

stages.label: Intended learning
stages.description: Abstracts should make a clear claim and situate it for a disciplinary reader.

stages.label: Evidence
stages.description: Each student reads a peer draft against two criteria and one short exemplar excerpt.

stages.label: Interpretation
stages.description: The peer names the strongest claim and one quality gap relative to the exemplar.

stages.label: Action
stages.description: The author revises one sentence to close that gap before tutor feedback.

body.synthesis: Peer and self contributors enrich judgement and action inside the original four-part loop; they do not add mandatory new stages.

materials.formal_notes: AUTHOR-ONLY S5: Keep the example inside the evidence-to-action loop; do not invent worksheets.

body.title: Integrated formative design loop

elements.label: Intended learning
elements.guiding_question: What should learners become able to do?

elements.label: Useful evidence
elements.guiding_question: What will make current understanding visible?

elements.label: Interpretation and judgement
elements.guiding_question: What does the evidence mean against intention?
elements.supporting_text: May involve lecturer, peer, or self.

body.caption: The S2 loop returns with richer judgement roles; contributors are not extra stages.

materials.formal_notes: AUTHOR-ONLY S6: Preserve continuity with S2; no competing framework.
